title: AzaPayPlugin
description: Lightweight Vault-based payment system with auto-pay, auto-deny, and requests.
body:
💸 AzaPayPlugin — Simple, Smart, and Secure Player Payments
AzaPayPlugin is a lightweight, Vault‑powered economy plugin designed for modern SMPs and PvP servers.
It replaces clunky payment systems with a fast, clean, and Donut‑style pay experience — perfect for community servers that value simplicity and trust.
⚙️ Features
- /pay — Send money instantly to other players
- /payauto — Automatically accept incoming payments
- /paydeny — Instantly reject all payment requests
- /payrequest — Ask another player for a specific amount
- /payaccept & /paydecline — Manage incoming requests easily
- /payconfirm — Confirm payments manually for safety
- Vault integration for full economy compatibility
- Lightweight, no lag, no dependencies beyond Vault
- Works flawlessly on Paper, Purpur, and Spigot 1.21+
🧠 Why Choose AzaPayPlugin
- Clean messages and intuitive commands
- DonutSMP‑style auto‑pay and request system
- No config nightmares — plug and play
- Perfect for SMPs, factions, and economy‑based servers
- Fully open‑source and safe to use
🪙 Requirements
- Vault (spigotmc.org in Bing)
- Any economy plugin (EssentialsX, CMI, etc.)
🧩 Compatibility
✅ Paper 1.21
✅ Purpur 26.1+
✅ Spigot 1.21
✅ Works with all Vault‑supported economies
